name: finding-unknowns
description: Keep your own map of what you know and do not know, and update it only on evidence. An always-on text (CLAUDE.md, 127 words, appended by hand or by install.sh) shows a four-quadrant map before non-trivial changes and then waits for your reply (fu:before: KK what you rely on, KU what is open, UK what the assistant assumes you want, UU what you did not ask; say "just do it" to skip the wait), and shows what moved after the work (fu:after: expected vs found, now known, not proved, still unknown). The finding-unknowns skill holds the templates, an interview you start with /fu-interview, and a look-back over past Claude Code sessions with /fu-lookback. No agents or hooks; nothing is written to disk unless you say "save".
